problem: Stage29 validation deep-context fusion reduces FN but increases FP; channel/scale selection may improve this tradeoff. No claim that noise channels are already identified.

arms.eca_channel: Stage29 anchor residual path with ECA-like channel gating of context before fusion
arms.cross_channel: Same path; joint globally pooled context+skip descriptor predicts 64 per-image context channel weights
arms.cross_channel_scale: cross_channel plus conditional per-hidden-channel softmax selection of 3x3/5x5 branches

ablation_structure: ECA vs condition-aware channel gating; conditioned gating vs conditioned gating+scale selection. Common backbone, decoder path and loss unchanged.
initialization: All old shared weights copied by deterministic construction; channel gains 2*sigmoid initialized1, scale weights .5/.5, original zero residual projection retained. Formal models start from official pretrained weights, not trained Stage29 checkpoints.
eca_adaptation: Global spatial mean + Conv1d(kernel3); multiplier2 and zero init differ from standard sigmoid ECA to ensure exact identity at initialization. Original implementation retained in research folder for attribution.
selection_scope: Channel and kernel-scale weights are per image, not per spatial location; existing spatial residual gate remains. No interpretation as calibrated reliability or named anatomical channels.

training.lr_schedule_note: Explicit exception to new100-epoch schedule default: reuse exact Stage29 first100-of300 curve so historical controls remain protocol-matched; do not change LR simultaneously with modules.
training.encoder: levels2/3 trainable, encoder eval, no DropPath

references: Stage29 control/local_fusion/anchor_fusion, already completed100 actual epochs; reuse best weights and metrics after source/checkpoint hashes and validation replay. No repeat baseline training.
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation per-image mean foreground Dice; earliest tie; test never used for epoch/hyperparameter selection
evaluation: all3 fixed selected new checkpoints get full validation replay and all867 test images; report old3 references separately; no comparison using last checkpoint
metrics: common evaluation.py macro/pooled Dice/IoU/precision/recall, Prec@ thresholds, threshold Jaccard, boundaryF1,HD95,per-image records; severe recall<.5 and area quartiles

development_screen.note: Practical validation-only screening, not proof of statistical significance. Results outside these thresholds still fully reported.

limitations: One seed; historical references subject to nondeterministic CUDA training variability
ECA and conditional variants have different parameter counts; cannot claim a capacity-matched isolation of conditioning
Observed test set is not a fresh independent confirmation
No channel or selective-kernel novelty claim; mechanism adaptation must earn evidence
completion: Done only after training and validation+test for all3 new models; no automatic parameter or seed sweep
